meta.doc_subtitle: Live project view — what we owe Paul over the next 90 days, where the team's attention sits, the asks we're waiting on, and the full task list with weekly status. Refreshes Mondays.

client_expectations.label: Hold spend, judge by scorecard
client_expectations.detail: Paul agreed to hold current budget for 90 days. Decision at day-90 review on whether the aggressive level is justified by booking-side movement, not just rankings.

client_expectations.label: Convert the visibility already won
client_expectations.detail: Maps share is strong (float 92%, near-me cluster all top-3). Plateau lives in on-site CTR + booking conversion. Plan emphasis is conversion lift, not more visibility.

client_expectations.label: Track bookings, not just rankings
client_expectations.detail: Scorecard now adds online bookings, website-sourced leads, and per-page conversion alongside calls and visibility. Paul explicitly named these as the metrics that matter.

client_expectations.label: Reverse float utilization slide
client_expectations.detail: Paul revealed float bookings have been declining despite Maps visibility holding. Float is now its own workstream — diagnostic + page rebuild pulled forward + float-specific scorecard lines.

client_expectations.label: Same accuracy standard as trigger point
client_expectations.detail: Every rebuilt service page is grounded in what BB's therapists actually perform — no medical-procedure overreach. Owner previews trigger point + lymphatic drainage pages before launch.

crucial_areas.label: Tracking buildout — bookings + per-page attribution
crucial_areas.detail: Without online-booking tracking and per-page lead/booking attribution, the day-90 scorecard can't answer Paul's question. This is the gate on the entire 90-day verdict.

crucial_areas.label: Float-specific workstream — diagnostic + rebuild forward
crucial_areas.detail: Float is the owner's named concern. Month 1 diagnoses why utilization is sliding; Month 2 rebuilds the page (pulled forward from Month 3) and applies whatever interventions the diagnostic surfaces.

crucial_areas.label: Trigger point page accuracy fix
crucial_areas.detail: Owner-flagged scope mismatch on /trigger-point-therapy/ (live page references medical injection + dry needling). Rewrite ships Week 1-2 with owner preview before launch.

crucial_areas.label: Service-page rebuild sequence in Paul's priority order
crucial_areas.detail: Trigger point M1; deep tissue + float + sports + prenatal M2; cranial sacral + reflexology + gua sha + Swedish + lymphatic drainage M3. Float moved from M3 to M2 per Paul's concern.

crucial_areas.label: Q2 close-out + budget verdict
crucial_areas.detail: Day-90 marker. Full scorecard delivered to Paul with a clean hold-or-pull-back recommendation against the agreed metrics.

asks.title: Confirm online-booking platform (Mindbody / Vagaro / Booker / Acuity / other)
asks.why: Without knowing the booking platform we can't track online bookings — the metric Paul named first. This single confirmation unblocks five downstream tracking tasks.

asks.title: Admin/export access to the booking platform (or a contact who can pull reports)
asks.why: We need actual booking data from the platform to set a baseline. Without it, every booking number on the day-90 scorecard is meaningless — there's nothing to compare against.

asks.title: Confirm primary phone number — 801-734-9798 (GBP) vs 801-855-5834 (chat)
asks.why: Site NAP says one number, GBP says another. Until Paul names the canonical, every CallRail attribution and GBP signal is fighting a mismatch.

asks.title: Float context conversation (15-30 min call)
asks.why: Paul flagged float utilization sliding despite high visibility but didn't say why. Owner context (pricing changes, hours, staffing, new competitors) gives the diagnostic a starting point data alone won't surface.

asks.title: Service-page + blog photo assets
asks.why: Rebuilt service pages need real interior + service-in-action photos. Stock imagery reads cheap on conversion-focused pages and undermines trust.

asks.title: Permission to add CallRail dynamic numbers per rebuilt service page
asks.why: Per-page call attribution requires multiple tracking numbers, one per rebuilt page. Cosmetic-only change — calls still ring through — but worth a heads-up so Paul isn't surprised.

asks.title: Trigger point page rewrite preview before launch
asks.why: Paul explicitly asked for 'no surprises' on the trigger point page. Honoring this is a trust-building moment that protects the broader budget conversation.

asks.title: Confirm cupping is still an offered service
asks.why: If cupping is still on the menu we 301 the broken URL to the canonical; if not we prune. Five-second answer, gates a quick architecture win.

tasks.title: Confirm BB's online-booking platform
tasks.why: First gate on the whole tracking buildout. Until we know what platform powers BB's online bookings, nothing downstream can be wired.
tasks.guidance: Ask Paul via email (see ASK-1) or short-circuit by loading the booking widget on the site to identify the platform. Common signatures: Mindbody (clients.mindbodyonline.com), Vagaro (booking.vagaro.com), Booker (booker.com), Acuity (acuity.com).

tasks.title: Map platform's booking-event options (thanks-page redirect vs widget event vs CSV fallback)
tasks.why: Different platforms expose booking events differently. Choosing the cleanest method prevents weeks of dead-end implementation downstream.
tasks.guidance: Output is a 1-pager naming chosen method + implementation requirements. Best case = thanks-page redirect (clean GA4 tag); middle = widget event callback (needs platform support ticket); fallback = monthly CSV export from admin dashboard.

tasks.title: Pull 3-6 mo of booking baseline data
tasks.why: A scorecard line saying 'bookings: 47' means nothing unless we know whether 47 is up or down from before. Baseline turns the metric into a decision.
tasks.guidance: Pull last 6 months of completed bookings if data goes back that far, otherwise last 3 months. Capture: total bookings/month, breakdown by service, online vs phone vs walk-in split. File to BB exports/booking_baseline_2026Q2.csv.

tasks.title: Stand up booking-event tracking in GTM/GA4
tasks.why: Implementation of the method 1.2 picks. Once this fires, every Paul-facing booking number from this point forward is real, not guessed.
tasks.guidance: If thanks-page event: standard GTM tag firing on URL match. If widget callback: postMessage listener + dataLayer push. If CSV fallback: monthly import script via Measurement Protocol. Test end-to-end with a real booking, verify in GA4 DebugView.

tasks.title: Enable CallRail dynamic number insertion per rebuilt service page
tasks.why: Dynamic Number Insertion is what lets us say 'this call came from the trigger point page' instead of 'this call came from the website.' Foundation for per-page call attribution.
tasks.guidance: Open CallRail support ticket: enable DNI on each rebuilt service page slug (/trigger-point-therapy/, /deep-tissue-*, /sports-massage*, /prenatal-massage*, /float-therapy*, /myofascial-release*, /lymphatic-drainage-massage*). Add CallRail swap script to GTM. Verify on test page.

tasks.title: Tag 'Book Now' buttons with ?source=<page-slug> URL parameter
tasks.why: Carries page attribution through the booking flow. Without this, even if the booking lands cleanly, we can't tie it back to a source page.
tasks.guidance: Every rebuilt service page template: Book Now href = platform-url?source=<slug>. Verify booking platform stores the source param (custom field, notes, or platform's own source tracking). Bake into 1.12 + 2.1 + 3.1 + 3.2 rebuild templates.

tasks.title: Audit form_submit event fires with page URL parameter
tasks.why: Per-page conversion requires every form submission to remember its source page. Probably already configured but unaudited — verify before building reports on top of it.
tasks.guidance: Check GTM container for form_submit + contact_form_submit triggers. Verify GA4 event tag includes page_location parameter. Test submit on staging, verify in DebugView. If missing, add page_location as event parameter.

tasks.title: Build per-page conversion row in scorecard (sessions / calls / form leads / bookings)
tasks.why: This is the literal answer to Paul's 'did the rebuilt pages start converting better' question. Every rebuilt page gets its own row, judged on its own merit instead of an average.
tasks.guidance: New scorecard section 'Per-page lift'. For each rebuilt page: monthly sessions (GA4), calls (CallRail per-number), form leads (GA4 form_submit by page_location), bookings (GA4 booking_complete by source). Pre-rebuild baseline vs running monthly.

tasks.title: Add float-specific scorecard lines (page sessions, bookings, % of total)
tasks.why: Paul directly asked for float-specific demand and booking growth tracking. Three lines on the scorecard answer it.
tasks.guidance: Three new scorecard lines: /float-therapy/ page sessions (monthly), float-attributed bookings (booking_complete with source=float-therapy), float share of total bookings (%). Include trailing 6-mo trend so Paul sees the slide reversing — or not.

tasks.title: Run float demand diagnostic
tasks.why: Paul's float concern doesn't have a known cause yet. The diagnostic figures out whether it's demand, on-page, booking-flow, or competitive — and the answer changes M2 interventions entirely.
tasks.guidance: 1-page memo with four cuts: SEARCH DEMAND (Trends + GSC + DataForSEO volumes 24mo), ON-PAGE BEHAVIOR (GA4 behavior on /float-therapy/), BOOKING FLOW (walk through as customer, find drop-off), COMPETITIVE (nearby float operators — pricing, memberships, packaging changes).

tasks.title: Sitewide phone NAP fix — replace 801-855-5834 with 801-734-9798 GBP primary
tasks.why: One-shot fix that hurts every downstream signal until done. Confused NAP weakens GBP rank and breaks CallRail attribution before either gets started.
tasks.guidance: Sweep entire site: header, footer, contact page, all service pages, chat widget, LocalBusiness JSON-LD telephone field. Verify 6 sample pages post-deploy. Validate JSON-LD in Rich Results Test. Request re-crawl in GSC.

tasks.title: Trigger point page rewrite — remove injection + dry-needling refs, add Service + FAQ schema
tasks.week_status_note: Draft starting; Paul previews before launch (ASK-7)
tasks.why: Owner-flagged accuracy fix on a page that currently misrepresents what BB does. Paul reviews before launch — this is the credibility moment for the budget retention.
tasks.guidance: Same URL + booking flow. Remove every injection + dry-needling reference. Add short labeled section distinguishing manual trigger point from those procedures. Service + FAQ schema + intake CTA above fold. Bake ?source=trigger-point-therapy into Book Now button. Send to Paul for preview before deploy.

tasks.title: Resolve duplicate /trigger-point-therapy/ canonical via small-level 301
tasks.why: Duplicate canonical splits ranking signal. Quick 301 cleanup after the rewrite ships consolidates the equity onto one URL.
tasks.guidance: After SP-01 ships, identify canonical URL post-rewrite. 301 the deprecated URL to the canonical. Audit internal links: zero links should point to deprecated. curl-verify the 301 chain ends 200. Submit canonical for re-crawl.

tasks.title: Fix /cupping-massage/ 404 — 301 to canonical, update internal links
tasks.why: Broken URL with 10+ orphaned internal links. Quick win that recovers wasted link equity.
tasks.guidance: If Paul confirms cupping is still offered: 301 /cupping-massage/ to /modalities-techniques/cupping/ canonical. Pull internal links via Screaming Frog or GSC links report. Update each to the canonical URL. Submit canonical for re-crawl.

tasks.title: Ship new location pages per subscription scope — catchment × service gap targeting
tasks.why: Production-scale catchment × service capture. Pleasant Grove and Cedar Hills are the gaps the matrix testing surfaced last quarter.
tasks.guidance: Target list per subscription scope (Aleksa picks): Cedar Hills × DT, PG × cupping, Lehi × Swedish, Lindon × prenatal. Each page Service + FAQ schema + intake CTA + canonical phone (from 1.11) + Book Now ?source= param. Real catchment focus, not doorway.

tasks.title: Ship blog deliverables per subscription scope — Q-format + refresh + cluster mix
tasks.why: Continued blog cadence keeps the AI-citation surface fed (150+ AI Overview citations last 30 days). Refresh-cohort updates recover clicks faster than chasing new topics.
tasks.guidance: Mix per subscription scope: 1 Q-format LLM-targeted post (example: 'Is float therapy safe during pregnancy?' with FAQ schema), refresh-cohort updates on existing strong content, cluster builds on float/prenatal/DT. Every post BlogPosting schema + internal link to rebuilt trigger point page.

tasks.title: Ship on-topic geo pages per subscription scope — wellness / athletic recovery / postpartum angles
tasks.why: On-topic geo (wellness, athletic recovery, postpartum) captures geo + modality long-tail without doorway risk. Each page deep-links service hubs.
tasks.guidance: Candidate angles: Wellness Resources Cedar Hills, Athletic Recovery Utah Valley Runners, Postpartum Wellness Utah Valley. Each deep-links 3-4 service hubs. Schema: WebPage + breadcrumb. Real content, not 200-word doorway shells.

tasks.title: Tier-1 manual citations — AMTA + ABMP + Utah MTA + Utah County Chamber + PG Chamber
tasks.why: Replaces the halted SEO Neo stack with citations that hold up long-term. Professional bodies + chambers feed the next DA jump.
tasks.guidance: 5 Tier-1 targets. Each submission: full NAP (canonical phone from 1.11), description, services, hours, photos. Log submission date, expected approval window, URL when live in tracker.

tasks.title: LD scan baseline + GSC + GA4 Q2 baseline exports
tasks.why: Locks the Q2 starting line. Without a frozen baseline at day 0, the day-90 verdict has nothing apples-to-apples to compare against.
tasks.guidance: LD: 32 queries (existing 18 + 14 untracked services). GSC: last 365 days queries + URLs + clicks + impressions + CTR + position. GA4: Dec 2024-May 2026 sessions + conversions + events + channel split. DataForSEO Business Data scrape. Output '1-pager Q2 baseline locked.'

tasks.title: Service-page rebuild batch — Deep Tissue + Sports + Prenatal + Float (moved up from M3)
tasks.why: Paul's named priority list for the conversion-lift work. Float pulled forward because Paul flagged it as both a concern and a priority.
tasks.guidance: Universal-template upgrade with Service + LocalBusiness + FAQ schema, intake CTA above fold, canonical phone, Book Now ?source= param. Float is the new add — pulled forward per Paul's priority signal.

tasks.title: Float-specific off-search interventions from 1.10 diagnostic
tasks.why: If the float diagnostic surfaces a pricing, packaging, or booking-flow problem, search work alone won't fix it. These are the off-search levers — most need Paul sign-off.
tasks.guidance: Whatever the diagnostic memo surfaces: pricing block, package CTA, booking-flow fix. Some items need Paul sign-off (pricing/packages). Tied to ASK-4 follow-through.

tasks.title: Build /myofascial-release/ page — 590 UT vol; BB #1 at AF pin without dedicated page
tasks.why: BB already ranks #1 at AF pin for myofascial release with no dedicated page. Building one captures a search surface we're already winning by accident.
tasks.guidance: Missing-page capture. Service + FAQ schema. Internal-link from refreshed trigger point page and deep tissue page.

tasks.title: Small-level 301-to-MAIN cleanup batch on 84 redundant URLs
tasks.why: 84 URLs are splitting ranking signal across redundant versions. Consolidation to canonical recovers the equity without bulk NOINDEX risk.
tasks.guidance: NEVER bulk NOINDEX. Per-URL canonical target documented + curl-verified. Per the Cannibal_Cleanup_Plan workbook decisions.

tasks.title: Repurpose 19 off-topic geo URLs with on-topic wellness/athletic angle
tasks.why: Off-topic geo URLs are dead weight. Repurposing keeps the URL signal but restores topical relevance.
tasks.guidance: Keep the URL, swap the content. On-topic wellness/athletic angle. Deep-link to service hubs.

tasks.title: Ship new location pages M2 per subscription scope — PG cross-suburb angle
tasks.why: Pleasant Grove is the most contested catchment — the field moved most there last quarter. Cross-suburb angle captures the shifting opportunity.
tasks.guidance: Pleasant Grove cross-suburb angle. Matrix gaps from last quarter's competitive analysis.

tasks.title: Ship blog deliverables M2 per subscription scope
tasks.why: Continued cadence; M2 Q-format pairs with the trigger point rewrite for topical authority.
tasks.guidance: Q-format example: 'Trigger point therapy vs dry needling.' Refresh + cluster mix continues.

tasks.title: Ship on-topic geo pages M2 per subscription scope
tasks.why: PG-focused cohort builds on the cross-suburb location page strategy.
tasks.guidance: PG-focused.

tasks.title: Tier-2 manual citations (local mom + wellness directories)
tasks.why: Continues earned-authority rebuild post-halt with vertical-relevant citations.
tasks.guidance: Local mom + wellness directories. Same submission discipline as Tier-1.

tasks.title: Mid-quarter delta report — indexation on refresh URLs, SP-01 + TPL-01 30-day CTR delta
tasks.why: First marginal-value read. Indexation + CTR delta on M1 fixes tells us whether the work is moving the needle 30 days in.
tasks.guidance: Indexation rate on refreshed URLs + CTR delta on trigger point + cupping fix. Backlink profile re-check post-disavow if filed.

tasks.title: First per-page conversion read on M1 rebuilds (trigger point, cupping fix)
tasks.why: This proves whether the attribution wiring actually works. If trigger point page conversion moved post-rebuild, that's the proof point for the day-90 verdict.
tasks.guidance: Uses tracking stood up in M1. Trigger point pre-rebuild baseline vs 30-day post. Same for cupping fix.

tasks.title: Updated scorecard delivery to Paul — now includes booking, float, per-page lines
tasks.why: Mid-quarter checkpoint. Paul reviews the new tracking lines and flags anything mistracking before the day-90 verdict — better to fix at week 6 than week 13.
tasks.guidance: Send to Paul with a short cover note pointing at the new sections. Schedule 20-min review.

tasks.title: Service-page rebuild batch — Cranial Sacral + Reflexology + Gua Sha + Swedish
tasks.why: Modality-differentiator round. Swedish moved from M2 when float moved up; these are the cards BB has that most local competitors don't.
tasks.guidance: Full schema + intake CTA + canonical phone + Book Now ?source= param.

tasks.title: Build /lymphatic-drainage-massage/ — un-gated post Paul's confirm; same accuracy guardrail as trigger point
tasks.week_status_note: Paul confirmed manual LD; build proceeds
tasks.why: 3,600 UT monthly searches at #2 rank without a dedicated page today. Paul confirmed manual LD; same accuracy standard as trigger point.
tasks.guidance: Manual-only claims, no medical-procedure framing. Paul reviews outline before launch (same as trigger point).

tasks.title: Sitewide schema audit + BlogPosting on top blog posts + BreadcrumbList sitewide
tasks.why: Closes schema gaps; BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList rollout feeds rich-result eligibility across the site.
tasks.guidance: Top 10 blog posts get BlogPosting schema. BreadcrumbList sitewide. Full audit report filed.

tasks.title: Final cleanup pass — REVIEW cohort case-by-case + typo URL fix + final REFRESH batch
tasks.why: Closes the cleanup tail. Long-running architecture work resolves before the close-out so the day-90 site is clean.
tasks.guidance: 14 REVIEW-cohort URLs decisioned case-by-case. Typo URL fix. Final refresh batch (3-4 URLs).

tasks.title: Ship new location pages M3 per subscription scope
tasks.why: Final matrix gaps from the quarterly competitive analysis.
tasks.guidance: Remaining matrix gaps.

tasks.title: Ship blog deliverables M3 per subscription scope
tasks.why: Final blog cohort; M3 Q-format ties to the cupping page work and the athletic-recovery vertical.
tasks.guidance: Q-format example: 'Cupping for athletic recovery in Utah.' Refresh + cluster mix continues.

tasks.title: Ship on-topic geo pages M3 per subscription scope
tasks.why: Final geo cohort, closing out the 90-day production volume.
tasks.guidance: Final geo cohort.

tasks.title: Tier-3 manual citations (athletic / float / recovery directories)
tasks.why: Float-vertical citations match the float concern Paul raised — same trust-building motion as the rebuild work.
tasks.guidance: Athletic / float / recovery directories. Final citation tier.

tasks.title: Q2 close-out report — planned → executed → impact correlation against full scorecard
tasks.why: The day-90 verdict. Marginal-value read across rankings + AI + calls + leads + bookings + per-page + float lines.
tasks.guidance: Every task row Result/Notes + Evidence. KPI scorecard against M3 actuals. Marginal-value verdict documented.

tasks.title: Q2 close-out + budget verdict delivered to Paul
tasks.why: The point of the whole 90 days. Clean hold-or-pull-back recommendation against the agreed scorecard.
tasks.guidance: Hold-or-pull-back call against agreed scorecard. Endpoint of the 90-day deal.
